kind: delta addendum to the F1 configuration; the F1 configuration is immutable and remains authoritative for everything not defined here

draws.rng: python stdlib random.Random(42), a fresh instance per draw; no shared stream
draws.population_order: ascending: sessions by date; states by (session date, slot time)
draws.seed_order: sampler output order; 'first n in seed order' = first n of that output

d4_l2_sessions.population: eligible sessions in D-fit union D-eval with date in calendar year Y; 2023 starts at the D-fit boundary 2023-03-01; Jan-Feb 2023 not evaluated

d4t_l2_timestamps.population: the 90 L2 sessions sorted by date
d4t_l2_timestamps.procedure: for each session in date order: rng.choice(ten section-5 slots ascending)

d5_l3.population: all eligible states in D-fit union D-eval (eligible session x ten slots)
exclude: every development state (each d1 session x ten slots)
d5_l3.procedure: random.sample(pop, 50) after d1, d3, d4, d4t are fixed

draws.only_exclusions: L3 must not overlap S0, L2 or development

eligibility_domain: eligibility is evaluated only for dates inside a defined set
quantile_scope: all preregistered quantiles/percentiles/medians/cuts: section 8 E*, Z*, V*; section 9 scale constants; section 20 B3* max-probability tercile cuts; section 21 coverage cuts; any other

calendar_contract.item1: session file exists and weekday and not in core.market.nse_holidays.NSE_HOLIDAYS (literal)
calendar_contract.item4: d not in core.market.session_schedule.SPECIAL_SESSIONS (schedule override only; never sessionhood)
calendar_contract.item8_c_prev: core.market.trading_calendar.previous_session(d); its file must have a Nifty 50 bar stamped 15:29 with close > 0; no substitution
